products.title: API workflow rules (Source C) — the operational contract

claims.claim: Create / clone / delete events — SA only, Event Admin "unless granted"
claims.evidence: Zones `ADD_EXHIBITION=106` (`general/new`) and `EXHIBITIONS=501` gate it; `backend/app/library/Expo/AccessControl.php:172-174` maps `GENERAL` with `event_id=0` onto `ADD_EXHIBITION`. It is a grantable zone, not a superadmin privilege — clone is `universal/models/Events.php:4850`.

claims.evidence: Zone `general/edit` at `backend/admin/controllers/GeneralController.php:296`; `readonly` set for `zn ∈ {0,1}` at `:297`; write denial via `roleRestrictions` `:146-164`.
